stories.title: Follow live: Two defensive scores, Rudolph TD pass have Steelers on top
Sources: Bears TE Loveland awaiting second opinion on knee
stories.summary: The Bears are holding off on placing Colston Loveland on injured reserve while the injured tight end gets a second opinion on his left knee, sources told ESPN

stories.title: Pirates trade former No. 1 overall pick Davis to D-backs, sources say
stories.summary: The Pirates are sending former No. 1 overall pick Henry Davis to Arizona in exchange for utility player Tim Tawa, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan

stories.title: Flyers scratch top scorer Michkov, citing 'internal team matter'
stories.summary: Flyers top scorer Matvei Michkov was out of Philadelphia's lineup Friday afternoon "due to an internal team matter," the team announced.

stories.title: Ravens DB Humphrey to return to lineup, but role uncertain
stories.summary: Ravens cornerback Marlon Humphrey will play Sunday against the Texans, a week after he was benched for making disparaging comments about the city of Baltimore.
